paper.title: Multi-Armed Bandit Problem with Temporally-Partitioned Rewards: When Partial Feedback Counts

unmapped: Temporally-partitioned rewards: the reward of a pull is split into tau_max per-round rewards observed over the tau_max rounds following the pull (partial delayed feedback)
Maximum delay tau_max - 1 known to the learner
Cumulative reward of arm i bounded in [0, R_bar^i] (not [0,1])
settings.definition_quote: At every round $t \in [T]$, the learner pulls an arm $i \in \mathcal{A} = [K]$ and, from the pull of that arm, gets a \emph{per-round reward} $x_{t,m-t+1}^i$ at every round $m \in \{t, \ldots, t + \Tmax - 1\}$, where $\Tmax \in \mathbb{N}^*$ is the time span over which the reward is partitioned.

unmapped: Temporally-partitioned rewards observed over tau_max rounds after the pull
alpha-smoothness: the alpha consecutive blocks of phi=tau_max/alpha per-round rewards are independent, each with maximum R_bar^i/alpha
Learner knows tau_max, smoothness alpha and per-arm maximum cumulative reward R_bar^i
Cumulative reward of arm i bounded in [0, R_bar^i]
settings.definition_quote: In the TP-MAB setting, for $\alpha \in [\Tmax]$, we say that the reward is \emph{$\alpha$-smooth} if and only if $\frac{\Tmax}{\alpha} = \step$, with $\step \in \mathbb{N}$, and, for each $k \in [\alpha]$, the random variables $Z^i_{t,k}$ are independent and s.t.~$\overline{Z}^i_{\alpha,k}=\overline{Z}^i_{\alpha} = \frac{\overline{R}^i}{\alpha}$.

symbols.R_bar_max: max_i R_bar^i, the largest maximum cumulative reward of an arm

source.label: thm:lower
source.quote: The regret of any uniformly efficient policy $\mathfrak{U}$ applied to the TP-MAB problem is bounded from below by: \lim \inf_{T \rightarrow +\infty} \frac{\mathcal{R}_T(\mathfrak{U})}{\ln T} \geq \sum_{i:\mu_i < \mu^*} \frac{\Delta_i}{KL\left( \frac{\mu_i}{\overline{R}_{\max}}, \frac{\mu^*}{\overline{R}_{\max}} \right)}

results.notes: KL is Bernoulli KL on normalised means. Uniformly efficient = suboptimal arms pulled o(t^a) times. Theorem number inferred from \newtheorem counter order (first theorem).

symbols.alpha_s: smoothness parameter alpha in [tau_max] of the alpha-smooth reward

source.label: thm:loweralpha
source.quote: The regret of any uniformly efficient policy $\mathfrak{U}$ applied to the TP-MAB problem with the $\alpha$-smoothness property is bounded from below by: ... \geq \sum_{i:\mu_i < \mu^*} \frac{\Delta_i}{\alpha KL\left( \frac{ \mu_i}{\overline{R}_{\max}}, \frac{\mu^*}{\overline{R}_{\max}} \right)}.

results.notes: Theorem number inferred from counter order.

symbols.R_bar_i: maximum cumulative reward of arm i (upper end of support of R^i)

tuning: algorithm input alpha equals the true smoothness alpha

source.label: t:FRreg
source.quote: In the TP-MAB setting with $\alpha$-smooth reward, the pseudo-regret of \texttt{TP-UCB-FR} after $T$ rounds is: \mathcal{R}_T(\mathfrak{U}_{FR}) \leq \sum_{i:\mu_i<\mu^*} \frac{4(\overline{R}^i)^2 \ln T}{\alpha \Delta_i} ( 1 + \sqrt{1 + \frac{\alpha(\alpha + 1) \phi \Delta_i}{2 \overline{R}^i \ln T}} ) + (\alpha+1) \step \sum \overline{R}^i + ( 1 + \frac{\pi^2}{3} ) \sum \Delta_i.

results.notes: Confidence bound uses ln(t-1) so no horizon knowledge needed. Theorem number inferred.

symbols.R_bar_i: maximum cumulative reward of arm i

tuning: algorithm input alpha equals the true smoothness alpha

source.label: t:EWreg
source.quote: In the TP-MAB setting with $\alpha$-smooth reward, the pseudo-regret of \texttt{TP-UCB-EW} after $T$ rounds is: \R_T(\mathfrak{U}_{EW}) \leq \sum_{i:\mu_i<\mu^*} \frac{8(\overline{R}^i)^2\ln T}{\Delta_i} + \alpha(\step +\frac{\pi^2}{3}) \sum_{i : \mu_i < \mu^*} \Delta_i.

symbols.R_bar_i: maximum cumulative reward of arm i
symbols.tau_max: time span over which the reward is partitioned (max delay + 1)

source.label: t:d-alpha
source.quote: The pseudo-regret of \texttt{Delayed-UCB1} after $T \in \mathbb{N}^*$ rounds in the TP-MAB setting is: \mathcal{R}_T(\mathfrak{U}_{D-UCB1}) \le \sum_{i:\mu_i<\mu^*} \frac{8(\overline{R}^i)^2\ln{T}}{\Delta_i} + (1 + \frac{\pi^2}{3} + \Tmax )\sum_{i:\mu_i < \mu^*} \Delta_i.

results.notes: Appendix theorem analysing the authors' adaptation of Delayed-UCB1 (Joulani et al. 2013) to TP-MAB; treated as new analysis in this paper.
